data.message: I propose 10 tons each this month and whenever stock is 500. Total catch 250 leaves 250, so next month returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That gives each of us $10,000 every month indefinitely if we cooperate. Bigger requests offer a one-time gain but risk destroying future income. If stock falls below 500, let's coordinate lower catches before fishing. Will you commit to the 10-ton cap?
